text: Entry Requirements 1. Under the age of 25, senior high school graduation or with equivalent qualification of 12-year education background. Mathematics, physics and chemistry with 60 of total marks results are necessary for engineering degree courses. 2. English competence certificates: -Applicants from countries where English is the official language are exempt from proof of English language proficiency. -The applicants that use English as the language of instruction at high school, may use the language certificate issued by the high school. -If the applicant does not meet any of above criteria, then IELTS or TOFELresult is preferred. -If the applicant cannot provide any English competence certificate mentioned above, SAU will evaluate the applicant's English level by checking the English self-introduction video and English result on the transcript. 3.
